why_ai: Pure software sold on outcomes; demand grows with AI though model labs squeeze the platform layer.
why_clarity: Task completion is measurable but nobody can predict reliability, and fixes are case-by-case patches.
why_digital: Code, models and connectors built and delivered on screens, sold remotely to engineering teams.

why_ai: Risk owners stay accountable for what agents may do, but gate placement is learnable from trajectories.
why_clarity: Gate placement is guessed by intuition and costly failures are rare, so feedback is slow.
why_digital: Policy is set over agent trajectories and permission scopes entirely in software.

why_ai: AI-native software whose demand grows with AI, with no licence or personal relationship protecting it.
why_clarity: Frameworks and outcome products have checkable outputs, but reliability varies unpredictably across customers.
why_digital: Orchestration, state and tool-calling machinery built and sold as software.

why_ai: Integration code against customer systems is largely generatable by coding agents by 2031.
why_clarity: A connector works or fails testably, though each customer's legacy semantics differ.
why_digital: Work starts from APIs and schemas and ships as integration code.

why_ai: Clustering failures and regression testing are mechanical tasks that tooling will automate.
why_clarity: Failures cluster into named causes and fixes are verified by rerunning regression tests.
why_digital: Inputs are logged agent trajectories and outputs are tests and fixes in software.

why_ai: Frameworks are often free and model providers keep absorbing orchestration into their own SDKs.
why_clarity: Engineering requirements like replay, state and testability are concrete and checkable.
why_digital: Open-source code adopted by engineers anywhere, delivered and supported online.

why_ai: Predicting agent success is novel and high-stakes, but it is learnable from trajectory data.
why_clarity: Predicted completion share is checkable after deployment, yet no agreed method exists to produce it.
why_digital: Inputs are task sets and trajectories; output is a prediction report.

why_ai: Humans stay needed to repair agent mistakes for angry customers, but the work is unlicensed support.
why_clarity: Resolution is visible, but each inherited failure differs and the agent's actions are often unexplained.
why_digital: Support staff work from transcripts and tool logs over chat or phone.

why_ai: Engineers embedded in customer businesses translate messy processes, though repeat work is being productised away.
why_clarity: Each deployment's edge cases differ and engineers tune workflows by feel.
why_digital: Work is software, but engineers sit inside customer organisations for weeks.

why_ai: Mining a structured trajectory corpus is analysis the platforms can automate themselves.
why_clarity: Questions are clear but answers about approval placement and recoverability take time to validate.
why_digital: Millions of logged trajectories analysed entirely in software.

why_ai: The product itself is AI replacing outsourced labour, so demand grows, but nothing protects the vendor.
why_clarity: Resolved tickets and merged pull requests are countable outcomes in repetitive bounded domains.
why_digital: Tickets, code and operational tasks are handled and delivered in software.
